name: Data dependency

subjectOf.text: The FSOC's three stage SIFI review process depends heavily on information that private fund investment advisers supply through Form PF.
subjectOf.abstract: FSOC's three-stage review process for SIFI designation153 depends heavily on the information provided by private fund investment advisers in Form PF.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2470008
scope_conditions: SIFI review of private funds and their advisers

subjectOf.text: Form PF information addresses most of the FSOC's stage one thresholds either directly or indirectly, so the mechanical screen runs largely on adviser reported data.
subjectOf.abstract: The information in Form PF either directly or indirectly addresses most of FSOC's stage one thresholds.
